subject: Cutover timeline, cohort plan, and exception routing
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acropolishealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-08-10 09:17 -0700
Subject: Cutover timeline proposal + ask: preferred cohort cadence

Team / Elena —

Quick note to get alignment on target cutover windows for Acropolis. Attached is a proposal matrix (cutover_matrix_v2.xlsx) with three lanes:
  - Option A: 2028-09-06 — single-day global cutover (high-risk).
  - Option B: 2028-09-13–20 — phased cohorts by region (preferred for latency testing).
  - Option C: rolling weekends (low blast radius, longer ops window).

Elena: can you confirm if Acropolis has a hard blackout period in mid-September? Also need to confirm whether Procurement needs DocuSign before we schedule any canaries.

Internal asks:
  - Product: can the feature-flag gate for the new routing logic be scoped to cohort IDs? (Ben)
  - Enablement: can we produce a 1-pager playbook for CS and SEs for each cohort? (Marissa / Vanessa)
  - Security/Legal: any extra attestation for the PHI customers in cohort 1? (Kim)

I propose we pick Option B tentatively and run a 3-customer canary on 9/13–9/14. If Ops/CloudWave has capacity, we can expand. Please see the attached matrix and customer_cohort_list.csv for suggested cohorts.

Thanks — I want to lock timeline by EOD Aug 16.

— Hannah
Product Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acropolishealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@acropolishealth.com>
Date: 2028-08-11 10:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Cutover timeline proposal + ask: preferred cohort cadence

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the options. A couple quick notes from Acropolis:
  - We have an internal maintenance window the week of 9/6 so Option A is out.
  - Procurement wants SOW + updated SLAs before any production canary. I copied them on this thread.
  - For HIPAA-scoped customers, we prefer them in the final cohort (not first canary). Can we make cohort 1 low-PHI?

We can do a small canary 9/13–9/14 with 3 non-PHI customers. I’ll follow up with procure@acropolishealth.com on DocuSign timeline.

— Elena
Director, Infrastructure Partnerships
Acropolis Health

On Fri, Aug 10, 2028 at 09:17 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team / Elena —
>
> Quick note to get alignment on target cutover windows for Acropolis. Attached is a proposal matrix...

Agree with Option B + 9/13 canary. Two immediate enablement gaps I see:
  1) The 1-pager: we should have a short runbook per cohort with escalation points (SE oncall, CS lead, product fallback). I attached an initial checklist (enablement_checklist_v1.md).
  2) Training: schedule two 30-min Q&A slots (one for SEs, one for CS) the week prior to canary — prefer 9/6 or 9/7.

Marissa: happy to own the runbook and Q&A scheduling. Ben: can you confirm whether the routing feature-flag can accept a cohort whitelist? If not, we need an alternate gate (customer tags).

— Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

On Sun, Aug 12, 2028 at 11:30 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Agree with Option B + 9/13 canary...

We can scope the routing gate to accept cohort IDs, but it will require a short product workstream:
  - Small API change to accept cohort_id on rollout call (ETA: 2 weeks dev + 1 week QA).
  - We can ship a temporary customer-tag fallback that Engineering Ops can toggle per customer (quicker).

For PHI customers: Kim, can you confirm whether customer_tag approach satisfies legal/compliance? If not, we should delay PHI until week 3.

I’ve attached customer_cohort_list.csv with the suggested canary picks (non-PHI rows flagged). Ops/CloudWave: please confirm capacity for 9/13–9/14.

— Ben
VP, Product Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acropolishealth.com>
Date: 2028-08-15 09:24 -0700
Subject: Re: Cutover timeline proposal + ask: preferred cohort cadence

Quick leadership sync —

Summary of constraints so we can finalize:
  - Acropolis blackout rules eliminate 9/6; canary on 9/13 is agreed by customer.
  - Procurement needs SOW/SLAs — legal to confirm signoff path.
  - Product gating: cohort_id support is the cleaner long-term path but customer_tag fallback is acceptable for canary.

Decision proposal for execs:
  - Approve Option B with canary 9/13–9/14 using customer_tag fallback.
  - If canary looks stable, expand cohorts 9/16–9/20.
  - Reserve 9/21–9/22 as contingency rollback window.

Action owners:
  - Marissa: runbook + Q&A scheduling (due 2028-09-07).
  - Ben: implement customer_tag runtime toggle and test (demo by 2028-09-10).
  - Kim: compliance attestation for cohort selection (due 2028-09-05).
  - Vanessa: CS playbook and escalation roster (draft by 2028-09-08).
  - Hannah: finalize timeline and confirm with Acropolis (I’ll own).

Please reply here with objections by EOD Aug 16; otherwise I’ll mark as approved and notify Execs.

— Jonas
Head of Product Strategy | Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: Cutover timeline & exception routing — actions and links

Thanks all — consolidating next steps here and locking the timeline:

Final decision: Option B approved. Canary 2028-09-13–09-14 (non-PHI customers). Expand cohorts 9/16–9/20 if canary is stable. Contingency rollback 9/21–9/22.

Assigned owners (recap):
  - Marissa Cole: runbook + Q&A scheduling (deliverable: enablement_checklist_v1.md) — due 2028-09-07.
  - Ben Carter: implement customer_tag toggle and provide demo 2028-09-10.
  - Kimberly Park: compliance attestation for cohort selection — due 2028-09-05.
  - Vanessa Ortiz: CS playbook + oncall escalation roster — draft due 2028-09-08.
  - Hannah Schmitt: confirm timeline with Acropolis, coordinate SOW path with Procurement.

Related links: https://confluence.redwood/launch/cutover-cohort-plan-2028-08 | https://hubspot.redwood/deal/ACR-3492
Attachments: cutover_matrix_v2.xlsx, customer_cohort_list.csv, enablement_checklist_v1.md

Elena / Procurement: please advise on SOW/DocuSign ETA so we can confirm the canary booking with Ops/CloudWave.

If no objections by EOD Aug 16 I will update Execs and schedule the pre-canary Q&A slots.

— Hannah
